verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.sentry.io returning HTTP 200 with a structured Sentry Documentation header. First-party docs add agent-oriented paths: `npx @sentry/ai install` teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Grok how to install and configure Sentry, and the MCP server supports reading documentation. Missing for 10: evidence of llms.txt depth or coverage (e.g. llms-full.txt or per-page markdown), independent or hands-on reports of agents actually using these docs.
